newsitem.title: GREECE: Greek FRNs auctioned at average a touch above par.
newsitem.headline: Greek FRNs auctioned at average a touch above par.

text.p: Greece auctioned 250 billion drachmas of seven-year floaters at an average price of 100.001475, the Bank of Greece said in a statement.
It said the minimum accepted price for the FRNs was 99.9211 and the highest price 100.25. The maturity date is October 23 2003 and the first coupon is set at 14.0 percent.
The spread is held constant at 150 basis points but the benchmark 12-month T-bill is slashed by 20 basis points to 12.50 percent.
